source.generator: new independent masked public-bit layered graph constructor; no F124AL or older graph generator imports
source.unknown_representation: src_bits[i]=null genuinely unknown/hidden to predictor; public carried/dst known 0/1, no secret oracle sidechannel; missing bit may conceal a real flip; don't count as known match or mismatch
source.semantic_truth: source-only existential intersection of allowed width-1/width-2 error-mask sets across observed event hops, positive nonempty and negative empty
source.negative: final unmasked event changes error-mask relative to earlier known masks through off-role donor swap, keeps total known and null token multiset intact

model.name: FIT-trained masked-recurrent belief calibration
model.engineered_features: Known raw16 bit mismatch mask, observed unknown-lane mask, candidate-anchor raw16 mask, per-event contradictions and missing-event count; NOT raw-bit operator induction, these are engineered and must be acknowledged.
model.state: existing node/raw16/score triple; score packed >32-bit integer stores anchor error-mask plus event count, contradiction count, partial masked counts; 7 active+9 retained original cell entries, zero extra cell fields
model.trainable: 6 logistic weights on path features [contradictions, validated_matches, masked_known_evidence, event_count, masked_event_count, bias]; per-edge readout only at target, FIT-only supervised SGD, no equality oracle in inference

FIT_training.selection: zero FIT false positives and >=72/144 FIT true-positive recall, max FIT correctly paired then smallest threshold; else report negative at fixed 0.1 diagnostic only

model.frozen_AK_original: unchanged original F124AK trained code and AK FIT SHA256 892155207d036b57ae62a29d77b51248fb4ec09bbe87621a88d0ceaeb1d4914a; it cannot directly parse masked null inputs, report incompatible and do not count as 0/48 comparator
model.ablation: same engineered recurrent features with initialized untrained weights and threshold 0.5

controls.deterministic_generalized: source-independent fixed set-of-compatible-masks updater; same 7+9 cells; stores allowable mask set and event count packed in original score; accepts 2-4 event chains with 1 or 2 flips and genuine unknown bits; no oracle/label input
controls.original_F124AL_generalized: requires fully known src bits; MUST report input incompatibility, not artificial loss
controls.fairness: report model weights/threshold bytes and actual OS RSS+CPU and packed scalar Python int byte costs; nominal 16 slots are not equal byte/computation parity
